action_failed.title: Action not completed
action_failed.message: We could not complete this action. Please try again. If the problem continues, contact the administrator.

invalid_credentials.title: Unable to sign in
invalid_credentials.message: We could not sign you in. Check your email and password.

session_expired.title: This page has expired
session_expired.message: Refresh this page and sign in again. If a translation was already submitted, do not upload it again.

sign_in_required.title: Sign in to continue
sign_in_required.message: Your session has ended. Sign in again to continue.

access_denied.title: You do not have access
access_denied.message: This action is not available for your account. Return to your dashboard or contact the administrator.

page_missing.title: Page not found
page_missing.message: This link may be outdated, or the item may no longer be available. Open your dashboard to continue.

rate_limited.title: Please wait a moment
rate_limited.message: Too many requests were made in a short time. Wait before trying again.

server_error.title: Unable to complete the request
server_error.message: We ran into a problem. Please try again later. If it continues, share the reference below with the administrator.

service_unavailable.title: Service temporarily unavailable
service_unavailable.message: We cannot reach the service right now. Please try again later.

translation_unavailable.title: Translation is unavailable
translation_unavailable.message: The translation service needs attention. Please contact the administrator before starting another translation.

status_unknown.title: Result not confirmed
status_unknown.message: We could not confirm the result. Your translation may still be running. Do not upload the file again. Share the reference with the administrator.

connection_lost.title: Connection interrupted
connection_lost.message: We could not reach the service. Check your connection. If you already submitted a document, do not upload it again.

pdf_save_failed.title: The PDF could not be saved
pdf_save_failed.message: We could not create a reliable PDF result. Review the file details or share the reference with the administrator.

partial.title: Some parts were not translated
partial.message: Some parts remain in the original language. Review the result before using it.

untranslated.title: No translated result was created
untranslated.message: The result still contains the original content. Review the document details before starting another translation.

preview.title: Image text needs review
preview.message: Text was read from images using an experimental option. Check the wording and page layout before using the result.

draft_saved.title: Draft saved
draft_saved.message: Your edits are saved. Select Save & Regenerate to update the downloadable file.

published.title: Download updated
published.message: The updated document is now ready to download.

job_retried.title: Another attempt is queued
job_retried.message: The saved original will be used for this attempt. Follow its progress in Translation Jobs.

job_unrecoverable.title: The original file is unavailable
job_unrecoverable.message: This translation cannot be restarted from the saved files. Ask the owner to upload the original again.

job_retry_failed.title: Another attempt was not confirmed
job_retry_failed.message: We could not confirm that another attempt was queued. Check the job status before trying again.

notifications_failed.title: Notifications could not load
notifications_failed.message: We could not load your updates. Refresh the page to try again.

clipboard_failed.title: Unable to copy
clipboard_failed.message: Your browser could not copy the text. Select the text and copy it manually.

file_unavailable.title: File unavailable
file_unavailable.message: We could not open this file. Try downloading it again, or contact the administrator.

download_started.title: Download started
download_started.message: Your browser is handling the download. Check its download list for the file.

check_fields.title: Check your details
check_fields.message: Please check the highlighted fields and try again.

login_form_expired.title: Please sign in again
login_form_expired.message: Your sign-in page expired. We have refreshed it. Enter your password again to continue.
